scope_guards: The ended 2,900-home register record is not presented as the current planning total.
The 947-unit uplift produces the 3,119-home remastered total and is not additive to it.
The 405-home Phase B reserved-matters package is a subset of the remastered envelope.
Fifty percent affordable is a tenure share and not additional capacity.
Condition 71 treatment does not prove Beam Park Station is operational.
The 854-home disposal figure spans Beam Park and Gascoigne East Phase 3B and is not Beam-only.
Named lease addresses and delivery windows do not prove whole-site completion or exact HMLR title topology.
No score or promotion is written without exact completion, title relation and executed overlays.
